The paper gives minimax conditional-independence testing results under smoothness restrictions, with total-variation separation and binned U-statistic procedures; it is not a constant-CATE testing result.

Exact journal theorem numbering remains a source-verification item because the primary full text was inaccessible.

Yu studies the variance-zero CATE-homogeneity null and claims consistency, asymptotic normality, and type-I control via intra-fold sample splitting under nuisance-learner conditions; it does not state a Hölder minimax separation frontier.

The paper gives kernel-based asymptotic tests for several conditional-treatment-effect nulls, including average-effect equality nulls; it is a relevant direct asymptotic predecessor but does not subsume the proposed minimax problem.
